items.title: The Best Don Nelson Story You'll Ever Hear
items.body_excerpt: RIP NELLIE 🕊️ We've told this story before and we're going to tell it again... there wasn't a cooler coach in the league than Don Nelson. After Game 6 in the We Believe run, we linked up with Nellie and lit one up. Thank you Nellie for believing in us. Rest easy.
